# Delhi Accord

`jmfsb_faction_delhi`

2040 Delhi Accord: Project TNI's Indonesian Armed Forces (its Malvinas camo) as an independent bloc - its men, armour, trucks and cars - with the base game's AAF / LDF air, AA, artillery, boats, drones and statics, Reaction Forces' Rams and jmfsb's own Mi-35 Hind.
